Upload attendance data

Use the same layout as the SIMS report: Student name, Year, Tutor, Days possible, Days present. Choose a .csv file, or copy the rows from Excel and paste them in the box.

Mock-up controls

These are only here so you can try the mock-up. In Apps Script, the sign-in comes from your Google account and the clock is live. Use Sign out at the top to switch between the VP, year teams and tutors.
